authorship: Original generated layouts; PasterDream block registry references only; upstream structures inspected as style references, never imported by generator.

structures.title: 微缩世界树主城
structures.description: Original miniature world-tree capitol: spreading roots and a hollow three-wide entry, a white quartz wraparound platform, branching trunk, asymmetric lobed crown of actual world-tree leaves, glass crystals and hanging dream lights. Reference: dyedream_worldtree, not dream_wishingtree; no source coordinates imported.
structures.role_status: Worker training, resource drop-off, 15 population, paid Shadow/Wind World Tree branches, economy research and Root Shelter.
structures.runtime_transform: DreamWorldTreeService chooses a versioned WorldTreeModel for paid upgrades; original named base data is retained for legacy saves.

structures.title: 梦生花园
structures.description: Original low mushroom-cap dwelling beside sixteen original wheat-bed asset positions; three-wide flat entry, raised dyedream-dirt beds, pink dreamwood dome and pale spots. Runtime replaces asset wheat with decorative wheat.
structures.role_status: Passive food (1 per 40 eligible ticks), 8 population and Garden Rest. Sixteen decorative wheat plants; manual farming, replanting and crop growth disabled.
structures.runtime_transform: DreamGardenPlacement replaces template minecraft:wheat with dreamseekers:decorative_garden_wheat. Saved-entry migration preserves legacy wheat ages.

structures.title: 逐梦货栈
structures.description: Original stationary segmented cargo depot: three copper-banded timber bays, dark low roof, a clear loading apron and short display rail siding. Crates are solid planks, not inventories; no train entity or automatic logistics is implemented.
structures.role_status: Owned worker resource drop-off. No automatic logistics or train entity.

structures.title: 潜影矿井
structures.description: Original semi-buried dark workshop and enclosed display shaft, with timber hoist, back rock bank and three-wide level entrance. The shaft is a bounded relief above an intact foundation, not terrain excavation. Runtime ore income is handled separately.
structures.role_status: Passive ore (1 per 40 eligible ticks); maximum two including unfinished sites. Decorative shaft never excavates terrain.

structures.title: 凝影炉场
structures.description: Original two-storey trapezoidal shadow furnace with a framed upper reservoir and an offset glazed descending channel. All glow is solid glass/amethyst/dream lamps: no molten shadow, water, lava or fire blocks. Runtime Shadow Energy income is handled separately.
structures.role_status: Passive Shadow Energy (1 per 100 eligible ticks), maximum two including unfinished sites, balance cap 1000; pauses for non-Dreamseeker owners.

structures.title: 破风训练庭
structures.description: Original compact knight ritual training courtyard: level three-wide rally ingress, inset ritual floor, open sparring yard, low broken walls and one equipment shelter. Existing troop-training role retained; no roster or balance changes.
structures.role_status: Six direct training recipes; support-unit recipes require a completed Ecology Court.

structures.title: 梦术礼堂
structures.description: Original compact asymmetric gothic hall: one small nave, three-wide arch, pointed purple windows, one offset tower and blue soul lamps. Runtime troop production and preparation are handled separately.
structures.role_status: Fourteen direct training recipes over three display pages; Hall Preparation requires a completed laboratory.

structures.title: 共鸣研究院
structures.description: Original low L-shaped dream laboratory: dark tiled wings with pink eaves, open courtyard and a stepped trapezoid instrument. Runtime receipt research is handled separately.
structures.role_status: Twenty-eight registered receipt research identities, including fifteen Wind tiers shown as three next-tier routes.

structures.title: 契约生态庭
structures.description: Original transparent faceted ecology dome over a planted tree, sealed decorative glass pool and an open three-wide animal approach. The blue pool is solid glass, not flowing water. Runtime care, contract support and codex are handled separately; the dome itself does not automatically tame creatures.
structures.role_status: Training prerequisite and neutral-contract support; two explicit permanent-ground-unit care posts, researched healing, owned visible-unit codex.

structures.title: 共鸣晶台
structures.description: Original low circular stepped ritual dais with a suspended-looking glass/amethyst crystal on a transparent central stalk, pale quartz ring and four dream lights. Runtime aura, network, pulse and ward are handled separately.
structures.role_status: Local production aura, linked resonance network, paid pulse and researched linked Dais Ward.

structures.title: 影灯守望塔
structures.description: Original narrow shadow-stone lamp column, purple light cage wrapped with trapdoors, copper collars and hanging chains. Three-wide front inspection approach; solid column has no interior. This is the retained legacy v1 asset; new construction uses the separate garrison v2 template.
structures.role_status: New model v2: three safe garrison positions, native occupied defense at range 24 and paid visible-target observation. Saved legacy v1 remains solid and cannot garrison.

asset_scope: size_xyz, palette_counts, non_air_blocks and sha256 on structures describe the original named base NBT asset. runtime_template_assets lists separately versioned shapes; review_revision 5 marks the thirteen reviewed redesigns. All original geometry and authorship are retained.
reserved_extensions: Generic DreamFunctionService role interface remains disabled; enabled functions use their dedicated services.
No automatic logistics, terrain excavation, or blanket neutral-creature taming is implied by building models.
